items.q: The Cockcroft & Gault equation is labelled in the book as:
opts: The only bedside formula still preferred
items.exp: Cockcroft & Gault equation: obsolete; not preferred now due to disadvantages (though it is a bed-side formula). (Book p735)

items.q: Fill up: In the Cockcroft & Gault creatinine clearance, the female result is the male formula multiplied by ______.
items.exp: CrCl = (140−age) × BW / (72 × S.Cr) in males; × 0.8 in females. (Book p735)

items.q: The denominator constant of the Cockcroft & Gault equation is:

Match each GFR equation with its origin — 1) MDRD equation 2) CKD-EPI equation 3) Schwartz equation … A) CKD-Epidemiology problem initiative group; best when GFR > 60 B) Society for modification of diet & renal diseases C) Estimates GFR in children
items.exp: MDRD = society for modification of diet & renal diseases; CKD-EPI = CKD-Epidemiology problem initiative group (best when GFR > 60); Schwartz = children. (Book p735)

items.q: Which of the following statements about GFR equations is TRUE?
opts: MDRD and CKD-EPI are the preferred equations now
Cockcroft & Gault is the preferred equation now
Schwartz equation is used in adults only
items.exp: MDRD and CKD-EPI are bracketed as 'preferred now'; CKD-EPI is best (advantage when GFR > 60). (Book p735)

items.q: All of the following are disadvantages of the Cockcroft & Gault equation EXCEPT:
opts: It uses race instead of weight
It overestimates GFR by assuming CrCl = GFR
Creatinine secretion makes CrCl = GFR + tubular secretion
It was developed when Cr was estimated by Jaffe's alkaline-picrate method
items.exp: Using race instead of weight is an advantage of MDRD/CKD-EPI; C&G over-emphasises BW, overestimates GFR and rests on Jaffe's method. (Book p735)

items.q: Fill up: The MDRD/CKD-EPI equations estimate creatinine with standard assays, namely ______ (isotope dilution mass spectroscopy).
items.exp: Advantage: equation uses estimation of Cr using standard assays: IDm (isotope dilution mass spectroscopy). (Book p735)

items.q: Because creatinine is secreted, the book writes creatinine clearance as:
opts: GFR + tubular secretion (or GFR − tubular absorption)
items.exp: Cr is secreted → CrCl = GFR + tubular secretion (clearance = GFR + tubular secretion or GFR − tubular absorption). (Book p735)
